$comment: Default configuration of the preparation priority engine (src/planner). Users override any part through the planner settings (configOverrides), which are deep-merged onto this file and validated.

importance.note: importance = √(topic effective weight ÷ heaviest topic's weight in the same exam). It compresses the long tail so mid-weight topics still surface.

historicalFrequency.note: Phase 2 trend = how reliably the topic appears in past papers. It scales importance: importance × (base + (1 − base) × trendScore).

classification.note: Score ≥ threshold → class (checked from Critical downward). Scores range 0–100.

examUrgency.note: Exam share = importance × (1 + urgencyBoost × urgency), urgency = 1 − daysLeft/horizon (0 when no date or further away than the horizon).

finalStretch.note: Within the final stretch before an exam, revision weighs more and starting low-importance untouched topics weighs less.

revision.note: Revision n+1 is due intervals[n] days after the last revision (or after the last study date when no revision exists yet). Only confirmed revisions count: a manual revision entry or a practice session marked as revision.
